title: Action Figure
description: Action figure, the action figure look, turns a person into merchandise: plastic joints, painted-on costume, blister-card studio lighting, a toy of a hero. Scale and material are the look, and a real actor in a costume is not enough.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Slightly high studio camera, 50mm, lock-off, as if the toy is on a card. Hard product keys, blister shine, visible joints, painted costume.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: A real actor in a costume, or a slide into Mighty Fighter. The tell is cloth weave and no joints.
Fix it: plastic, rivets, blister shine, toy scale.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Action Figure in film?
A merchandise recipe: plastic joints, blister-card lighting, a toy of a person. Material and scale, not a costume photograph.
Action Figure vs Mighty Fighter
Mighty fighter is a living champion pose. Action figure is the doll of that champion. If the skin is flesh, you wanted mighty fighter. If you see joints, you are here.
When should I use Action Figure?
Satire, kid myth, hero as product. Skip sincere war coverage unless the doll is the point.
How do I prompt Action Figure for AI image or video?
Studio toy light, then: Action-figure of [Subject], plastic joints, blister-card lighting, a toy of a person. Demand polymer and joints. Forbid readable packaging type.
